name: count_vertices
description: Counts total vertices in selected objects.

name: rename_object
description: Renames the active object.

name: select_hard_edges
description: Selects all sharp edges in the active mesh.

name: detect_ngons
description: Finds faces with more than four sides in the selected meshes.

name: triangulate_ngons
description: Triangulates every n-gon in the selected meshes.

name: detect_untriangulated_meshes
description: Finds quads and n-gons in meshes that must be delivered fully triangulated.

name: triangulate_meshes
description: Triangulates every quad and n-gon in the selected meshes.

name: detect_nonplanar_faces
description:
Finds quads and n-gons whose vertices don't lie on one plane.

threshold_deg: how far (in degrees) a vertex may bend out of the face's plane.
Slight bends are normal on organic models and harmless; 5° flags faces whose
diagonal choice visibly changes the shape.

name: triangulate_nonplanar_faces
description: Triangulates every non-planar face in the selected meshes.

name: detect_open_edges
description:
Finds holes and gaps: edges used by one face, edges shared by more than two
faces, and loose edges with no face at all.

Turn this check off for assets that are open on purpose, such as planes and cards.

name: detect_flipped_normals
description:
Finds faces whose normals point into the mesh instead of out of it.

Only closed parts of a mesh are checked: on an open surface, such as a plane,
neither side is "outside". Pieces that mostly face inwards are reported apart,
as inside out: they may be rooms or sky domes.

name: flip_normals_outward
description:
Flips faces that point the other way from the rest of their piece.

Pieces that mostly face inwards are left: they may be meant to be seen from
inside, like a room or a sky dome.

name: detect_color_attributes
description: Finds meshes that still have vertex colour attributes (colour sets).

name: remove_color_attributes
description:
Removes the vertex colour attributes no material on the mesh reads.

Colours a material uses (Color Attribute or Attribute node, also inside node
groups) are kept: removing them would change how the asset looks.

name: detect_unapplied_modifiers
description:
Finds meshes with modifiers that haven't been applied.

ignore: modifier types to allow, e.g. ["ARMATURE", "TRIANGULATE"]. Armature is
allowed by default because skinned meshes need it.

name: detect_intersecting_meshes
description: Finds faces where separate selected meshes intersect each other.

name: detect_over_triangle_budget
description:
Finds meshes whose triangle count exceeds a budget.

max_tris: the maximum number of triangles allowed per mesh, counted with
modifiers applied, as exported.

name: detect_over_vertex_budget
description:
Finds meshes whose vertex count exceeds a budget.

max_verts: the maximum number of vertices allowed per mesh, as counted in
Blender with modifiers applied. Engines count more where UV seams and hard
edges split vertices.

name: detect_unapplied_transforms
description:
Finds meshes whose scale isn't 1, or whose rotation isn't 0.

check_rotation: also require rotation to be applied, not just scale.
check_location: also require the asset to sit at the world origin (location 0, 0, 0).
Only top-level objects are checked for this: a part parented to another object,
like a wheel on a cart, is placed by its parent.

name: apply_transforms
description:
Applies scale (and rotation) on meshes with unapplied transforms, like Ctrl+A.

With check_location, also moves the asset to the world origin: its top-level
object moves, so its parts and its collision meshes move with it and keep
their places. Leaves objects whose look would change (modifiers that depend on
scale, custom normals with a non-uniform scale, negative scale, skinned or
animated meshes, shared mesh data).

name: detect_negative_scale
description:
Finds meshes mirrored with a negative scale.

By hand: apply scale, then Mesh > Normals > Recalculate Outside.

name: apply_negative_scale
description:
Applies negative scale into the mesh and keeps every face pointing the way it
did, whichever Blender version does the apply (4.x leaves faces inside out).

name: detect_off_center_pivots
description:
Finds meshes whose origin isn't at the bottom centre of their bounds.

tolerance_m: how far (in metres) the origin may be from the bottom centre.

name: move_pivots_to_bottom_center
description:
Moves each flagged mesh's origin to the bottom centre without moving the mesh.

Skips meshes with children or shared mesh data.

name: detect_wrong_unit_scale
description:
Checks the scene's unit scale, and optionally its length and rotation units.

scale_length: the expected Unit Scale (1.0 means 1 Blender unit = 1 metre).
length_unit: the expected length unit, e.g. "METERS" or "CENTIMETERS". Empty: not checked.
rotation_unit: the expected rotation unit, "DEGREES" or "RADIANS". Empty: not checked.

name: set_unit_scale
description:
Sets the scene's unit scale, and the length and rotation units if given.

When the unit scale changes, every top-level object is scaled about the world
origin by old / new scale, so real-world (and FBX export) sizes stay the same.
Children follow their parents. Object scale is changed, not mesh data, so
modifiers such as Bevel keep their look.

name: detect_missing_uv_maps
description: Finds meshes with no UV map at all.

name: detect_extra_uv_maps
description:
Finds meshes with more UV maps than allowed.

max_uv_maps: how many UV maps a mesh may have (1 means no second UV channel).

name: remove_extra_uv_maps
description:
Removes UV maps after the first max_uv_maps on each flagged mesh.

Keeps the render UV map (the one textures use) and any map a material reads by
name (UV Map, Normal Map, Tangent or Attribute node), so nothing changes look.

name: detect_uvs_outside_0_1
description: Finds meshes whose render UV map goes outside the 0–1 square. Selects those faces.

name: detect_flipped_uvs
description:
Finds faces whose UVs are mirrored (shown red in Maya's UV editor).

allow_overlapping: allow a mirrored face that sits on top of an unflipped one,
e.g. a symmetric shell stacked onto its other half.

name: detect_missing_lightmap_uvs
description:
Finds meshes without a lightmap UV channel, or whose lightmap UVs leave 0–1 or
overlap.

channel: index of the lightmap UV map (Unreal uses 1, the second map).
resolution: texels a side used to test for overlaps. Every face needs its own
space in a lightmap; faces that share texels at this size are flagged.

name: detect_missing_textures
description:
Finds Image Texture nodes with no image, a missing file, or an image that was
made or changed in Blender and not saved (e.g. a bake). Looks inside node groups.

name: relink_missing_textures
description:
Points each missing image at the file with the same name in the .blend's folder
or its subfolders, only when exactly one such file exists.

A stricter Find Missing Files: an image is never relinked to one of two files with
the same name. Images with no file (empty nodes, unsaved bakes) are left.

name: detect_color_space_issues
description:
Finds data maps (normal, roughness, metallic) set to sRGB, and colour maps set to Non-Color.

Float images (EXR, HDR) are skipped: they're linear on purpose.

name: fix_color_spaces
description:
Sets each flagged image to the colour space its role needs.

The role comes from the socket the image is plugged into directly: Base Color
means sRGB; Normal Map, Bump, Roughness and Metallic mean Non-Color.

name: detect_invalid_texture_sizes
description:
Finds textures that aren't power-of-two sized, or exceed a maximum size.

power_of_two: require both dimensions to be powers of two.
max_size: the largest allowed width or height, in pixels.

name: detect_wrong_texture_format
description:
Finds textures saved in a file format that isn't allowed.

formats: allowed formats, e.g. ["PNG"] or ["PNG", "TGA"]. Images generated in
Blender and never saved are skipped.

name: detect_unused_material_slots
description: Finds material slots no face uses, and empty slots that faces do use.

name: remove_unused_material_slots
description:
Removes slots no face uses, with Blender's Remove Unused Slots.

Objects with modifiers that may add faces with other materials (Solidify,
Bevel, Boolean, Geometry Nodes…) are left: Blender's operator only looks at
the mesh's own faces, so it would remove slots those modifiers use.

name: detect_textured_materials
description: Finds meshes whose materials use image textures, for deliveries that must have none.

name: detect_too_many_materials
description:
Finds meshes whose faces use more materials than allowed.

max_materials: how many different materials a mesh's faces may use.
Slots no face uses don't count (Detect Unused Material Slots finds those).

name: detect_unused_materials
description:
Finds materials in the file that no object uses. Checks the whole file, not just
the selection, and ignores Grease Pencil materials and ones with a fake user.

name: remove_unused_materials
description:
Deletes every material in the file that nothing uses, as Purge does.

These have no users, so Blender would drop them when saving anyway. Materials
with a fake user are kept.

name: detect_default_names
description:
Finds meshes and materials still using default names: Cube.001, pCube1, Box001,
geometry_0, Material.001, lambert1…

name: detect_invalid_name_characters
description:
Finds object and material names with characters the target doesn't allow.

pattern: regular expression every name must match.

name: fix_invalid_names
description:
Replaces invalid characters in flagged object and material names with underscores.

Collision meshes are renamed with their mesh (UCX_<new name>_NN), even if they
aren't part of the check, so the link between them never breaks.

name: detect_missing_name_prefix
description:
Finds render meshes missing a required name prefix. Collision meshes are ignored.

prefix: the prefix every static mesh name must start with.
skeletal_prefix: the prefix for skinned (skeletal) meshes. Empty: not checked.

name: add_name_prefix
description:
Adds the prefix to flagged meshes (SK_ for skeletal ones) and renames their
collision meshes to match, wherever they are in the scene.

name: detect_invalid_collision_meshes
description: Finds UCX_ collision meshes that don't match a render mesh name, or aren't convex.

name: detect_missing_collision
description:
Finds static meshes with no custom collision mesh (UCX_, UBX_, UCP_ or
USP_<MeshName>_NN).

Collision meshes are looked up in the whole scene, so selecting only the render
mesh is enough. Skinned meshes are skipped: engines can't use UCX_ collision on
skeletal meshes (Unreal uses a Physics Asset instead).

name: detect_excess_bone_influences
description:
Finds vertices weighted to more deforming bones than the engine supports.

max_influences: the most bones allowed to influence one vertex.

name: detect_unwanted_objects
description:
Finds objects whose type isn't allowed, e.g. cameras, lights and empties.

allowed_types: Blender object types to allow, e.g. ["MESH", "ARMATURE", "EMPTY"].
Empties named SOCKET_<name> are always allowed (Unreal sockets).

name: move_unwanted_objects
description:
Moves unwanted objects into a "Not for export" collection that is switched off.

Nothing is deleted. FBX and glTF exports skip switched-off collections, and so
do Vexa's checks. Tick the collection in the Outliner to bring them back.
Objects with children stay where they are.
